title: MoRAX: Mobility-based Representation Augmentation for Geospatial Foundation Models
summary: Geospatial Foundation Models (GFMs) are emerging as a powerful paradigm for learning semantically rich and geographically consistent visual and physical representations. However, their reliance on Earth-observation (EO) data leaves information about human activity largely underrepresented.
